_readme: Shortline Buick GMC daily Back Cover refresh log. One entry per day, newest first. The daily refresh job appends an entry and pushes; Vercel redeploys. status: ok | missed. On a missed day, WRITE THE ROW ANYWAY with status missed and a plain reason - a silent gap is the one thing this page exists to prevent.

entries.note: Second day held back by the same file-size limit. The build ran clean - 320 vehicles, 32 in and 13 out against the version now live - but the dealership platform caps this file at about 50 KB and the shortest usable version comes to 53.1 KB. The live page was left alone rather than dropped back to fewer vehicles, so it still lists the 301 from 8/29. Today's build did find a way to fit the whole lot inside the limit with room for months of growth, and that change is being reviewed before it goes on the site.

Today's file was built on schedule - 320 vehicles, 32 in and 13 out - but it was not placed on the site. The dealership platform caps this particular file at about 50 KB, and at 320 vehicles even the shortest usable version comes to 53.7 KB. Cutting vehicles back out to fit would have made the page less complete than it was yesterday, so the live file was left alone: it still lists the 301 vehicles from 8/29. The platform provides a second file slot with no such limit, and moving the inventory list into it is the fix being put in place.

9 vehicles in, 2 out, and one price change across the 301 now listed (176 new / 125 pre-owned). The lot grew by seven overnight, the first full day running on the dealership's own inventory feed. The price change: a 2017 Ford Escape SE moved from $15,840 to $13,840, and the file carried the new price the same morning - that is the whole point of a daily refresh, because an AI assistant quoting yesterday's price quotes a number the store will not honor.

The biggest change since this page went up: the file now lists the whole lot. Until today it carried 50 vehicles, the most the public feeds would expose. The dealership's own inventory system now feeds it directly, so all 294 in-stock vehicles are listed - 171 new and 123 pre-owned. Nothing was removed; the 244 additions are cars that were always on the lot but were not visible to an AI assistant before. To fit the platform's file-size limit at that count, each listing is now the vehicle, the price, the VIN and the link, rather than the longer spec line - the trade was full coverage over per-car detail, and the linked page still carries every spec and photo.

14 vehicles in, 13 out, 0 price changes across the 50 shown (25 new / 25 used). Clean build - every vehicle detail page answered on the first pass. The one arrival skipped on 8/26 did not come back; it had left inventory by this morning.

11 vehicles in, 12 out, 0 price changes across the 49 shown (24 new / 25 used). One first-time arrival was skipped when its detail page dropped the connection mid-fetch; it returns on tomorrow's build. This placement also cleared the 8/25 gap.
The file was built on schedule but was never placed on the live site, so the 8/24 version stayed up. Caught and corrected the morning of 8/26.
Daily refresh resumed and moved to an automated schedule. 4 vehicles added, 4 rotated out, 2 price changes across the 50 shown.
This cycle did not run. The refresh had been run by hand and no automated daily schedule existed yet. Fixed the next day: the refresh now runs on an automated daily schedule.

First full Watch refresh, run from the public feeds. 21 vehicles rotated out and 21 in since placement, plus 5 price changes caught (4 drops, 1 increase). The file now carries a dated rebuild stamp. Still capped at 50 vehicles until the DealersLink feed lands.
File placed and live on shortlinebuickgmc.com. Same 50 vehicles as the baseline, so nothing to compare yet. Daily add and remove counts start once the DealersLink feed is connected.
Baseline build. First index of the lot, so there is nothing to compare against yet. Daily additions and removals start with the next refresh.
